messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — running a short sprint to lock the launch claims for the benchmark webinar and the related one-pager. Need final copy for slides, battle snippets for field, and a condensed sales blurb. Goal: ship by EOD Thursday.

ash: +1. Can we make the 3 core differentiators crystal clear vs managed cloud endpoints and generic LLM APIs? Sales needs skimmable bullets.

miguel: Suggested three bucket differentiators: economics, operational guarantees, and degradation safety. Rough verbatim ideas below — please edit.

ash: Put metrics where we can (percent faster, cost delta) but flag with "internal benchmark" or similar. Reps love numbers.

sam: Agree with metrics, but legal will want source language. Avoid naming competitors directly; use category phrasing like "managed cloud inference" or "generic hosted LLM APIs".

katie: Also thinking inbound lead routing: can we create two CTA tracks on the landing page — "try hosted API" and "talk dedicated/private" — so SDRs can prioritize leads?

elaine: Here's a first pass block for the slide + one-pager. Please comment inline.

elaine: ```
- Predictable unit economics: fine-grained batching and routing controls that reduce token cost per inference versus generic managed endpoints (internal benchmark).
- One API, three deployment modes: ship with the same contract across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments for zero-app changes.
- Resilient serving: automatic routing to compact variants + region fallback to preserve latency SLAs during capacity spikes.
```

ash: I like the second one; change "zero-app changes" -> "no client changes". Also replace "compact variants" with "compatible compact model variants" (more precise).

miguel: Minor copy tweak: first bullet -> "Predictable per-inference economics via workload-aware batching, KV caching, and routing policies (see benchmark appendix)."

sam: Marketing legal check: avoid "preserve latency SLAs" unless we cite the SLA for Dedicated customers. Maybe "preserve latency under common load patterns".

katie: For the battlecard vs infra vendors: recommended framing — emphasize operational lift (we manage runtime + upgrades) and routing flexibility (pin -> dedicated, fallback -> hosted). Reps should ask: "How much engineering time do they want to spend on inference ops?"

ash: Add quick objection handlers for field:
- "We already run inference in our cloud" -> "Hosting is not just GPUs — serving runtime optimizations, smart batching, and routing policies drive predictable economics and less ops work."
- "We need on-prem" -> "We offer Private deployments with the same API and enterprise controls."

elaine: Good. Miguel — can you draft 2 sentence sales blurbs for each persona (platform, product, infra) by EOD today? Katie will wire inbound CTA routing.

miguel: On it. Will put 3 persona blurbs in the doc and link benchmark appendix.

marketing-bot: Reminder: copy freeze for webinar assets in 48 hours — add @legal and @sales-review if you haven't already.

sam: I'll ping legal now. @katie can you set up the two CTA paths in the MKT page draft and tag the SDR doc?

katie: Yep, creating the CTA experiments in Launchpad and will add a routing spreadsheet for SDR prioritization.

elaine: Thanks all — please mark "done" on the doc comment thread when you've updated your sections. Final check-in tomorrow 10:30am before packaging slides. :thumbsup:
